# MAZU Bar & Restaurant

> MAZU Bar & Restaurant is a beachfront restaurant located in Asparuhovo, Varna, Bulgaria, offering dining, drinks, live music, special events and online reservations.

The website is available in Bulgarian and English.

Visitors can explore the restaurant menu, discover upcoming events and access online reservations.

## Bulgarian website

- [Начална страница](https://restaurant-website-mu-mauve.vercel.app/bg): Информация за ресторанта, предстоящи събития и специални поводи.
- [Меню](https://restaurant-website-mu-mauve.vercel.app/bg/menu): Интерактивно меню на ресторанта.
- [Резервации](https://restaurant-website-mu-mauve.vercel.app/bg/reservations): Онлайн резервации.

## English website

- [Homepage](https://restaurant-website-mu-mauve.vercel.app/en): Restaurant information, upcoming events and special occasions.
- [Menu](https://restaurant-website-mu-mauve.vercel.app/en/menu): Interactive restaurant menu.
- [Reservations](https://restaurant-website-mu-mauve.vercel.app/en/reservations): Online reservations.
